SELECT A.GRADE_NO AS GRADE_NO, A.MODIFICATION_DATE AS MODIFICATION_DATE, A.PERIOD_NO AS PERIOD_NO, A.REGISTRATION_DATE AS REGISTRATION_DATE, A.RESUME_CONTENT AS RESUME_CONTENT, A.RESUME_DEL_FL AS RESUME_DEL_FL, A.RESUME_DEL_FL AS RESUME_HIDE_FL, A.RESUME_NO AS RESUME_NO, A.RESUME_TITLE AS RESUME_TITLE, A.SALARY_AMOUNT AS SALARY_AMOUNT, A.SALARY_NO AS SALARY_NO, A.WORKER_NO AS WORKER_NO, ( SELECT LISTAGG(D.WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_INFO, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY D.WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_NO) FROM WORKCOND_ADDRESS B JOIN WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE D ON B.WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_NO = D.WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_NO WHERE B.RESUME_NO = A.RESUME_NO ) AS WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_INFO, ( SELECT NVL(SUM( CASE WHEN E.END_DATE IS NULL THEN TRUNC(SYSDATE) - TRUNC(E.START_DATE) ELSE TRUNC(E.END_DATE) - TRUNC(E.START_DATE) END ), 0) FROM RESUME_CAREER C JOIN CAREER_INFO E ON C.CAREER_NO = E.CAREER_NO WHERE C.RESUME_NO = A.RESUME_NO ) AS TOTAL_CAREER, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM RECRUITMENT A WHERE -- 삭제되지 않은 공고 A.RECRUITMENT_DEL_FL = 'N' AND (
-- 1.학력 조건 A.GRADE_NO = ( SELECT B.GRADE_NO FROM RESUME B WHERE B.RESUME_NO = A.RESUME_NO )
-- 2. 급여 조건 OR ( A.SALARY_NO IN (1, 2) -- SALARY_NO가 1 또는 2일 때만 희망 금액 비교 AND A.SALARY_NO = ( SELECT B.SALARY_NO FROM RESUME B WHERE B.RESUME_NO = A.RESUME_NO ) AND A.SALARY_MOUNT >= ( SELECT B.SALARY_AMOUNT FROM RESUME B WHERE B.RESUME_NO = A.RESUME_NO ) )
OR A.SALARY_NO NOT IN (1, 2) -- SALARY_NO가 1, 2가 아닌 경우 SALARY_NO만 비교 AND A.SALARY_NO = ( SELECT B.SALARY_NO FROM RESUME B WHERE B.RESUME_NO = A.RESUME_NO )
-- 3.근무기간 조건 OR A.PERIOD_NO = ( SELECT B.PERIOD_NO FROM RESUME B WHERE B.RESUME_NO = A.RESUME_NO )
----- 여기까진 단순비교 이후로는 1:다 ) --
-- 4.근무요일 조건 OR A.DAYS_NO IN ( SELECT E.DAYS_NO FROM RESUME_DAYSTIME E WHERE E.RESUME_NO = A.RESUME_NO )
-- 5.근무시간 조건 OR A.TIME_NO IN ( SELECT E.TIME_NO FROM RESUME_DAYSTIME E WHERE E.RESUME_NO = A.RESUME_NO )
-- 6.근무형태 조건 OR A.JOBTYPE_NO IN ( SELECT F.JOBTYPE_NO FROM RESUME_JOB_TYPE F WHERE F.RESUME_NO = A.RESUME_NO )
----- 여기까진 1:다 이후로는 다:다) --
-- 7.희망지역 조건 OR A.RECRUITMENT_NO IN ( SELECT DISTINCT D.RECRUITMENT_NO FROM WORKCOND_ADDRESS C JOIN WORKCOND_ADDRESS D ON C.WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_NO = D.WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_NO WHERE C.RESUME_NO = A.RESUME_NO )
-- 8.업직종 조건 OR A.EMPLOYER_NO IN ( SELECT DISTINCT G.EMPLOYER_NO FROM RESUME_WORKTYPE H JOIN BUSINESS_WORKTYPE G ON H.WORKTYPE_NO = G.WORKTYPE_NO WHERE H.RESUME_NO = A.RESUME_NO )
) ) AS RECOMMENDATION FROM RESUME A WHERE A.WORKER_NO = #{workerNo} AND A.RESUME_DEL_FL = 'N' ORDER BY A.RESUME_NO DESC

SELECT A.RESUME_CONTENT AS RESUME_CONTENT, A.RESUME_DEL_FL AS RESUME_DEL_FL, A.RESUME_HIDE_FL AS RESUME_HIDE_FL, A.RESUME_NO AS RESUME_NO, A.RESUME_TITLE AS RESUME_TITLE, D.GRADE_NAME AS GRADE_NAME, A.SALARY_AMOUNT AS SALARY_AMOUNT, A.SALARY_NO AS SALARY_NO, A.REGISTRATION_DATE AS REGISTRATION_DATE, A.MODIFICATION_DATE AS MODIFICATION_DATE, ( SELECT NVL(SUM( CASE WHEN E.END_DATE IS NULL THEN TRUNC(SYSDATE) - TRUNC(E.START_DATE) ELSE TRUNC(E.END_DATE) - TRUNC(E.START_DATE) END ), 0) FROM RESUME_CAREER C JOIN CAREER_INFO E ON C.CAREER_NO = E.CAREER_NO WHERE C.RESUME_NO = A.RESUME_NO ) AS TOTAL_CAREER, ( SELECT F.PERIOD_NAME FROM WORKCOND_PERIOD F JOIN RESUME_PERIOD G ON F.PERIOD_NO = G.PERIOD_NO WHERE G.RESUME_NO = A.RESUME_NO ) AS PERIOD_NAME, B.PROFILE_IMG AS PROFILE_IMG, REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(B.WORKER_ADDRESS, '^\d+\^\^\^', ''), '\^\^\^', '') AS WORKER_ADDRESS, TO_CHAR(B.WORKER_BIRTHDATE, 'YYYY') AS WORKER_BIRTHDATE, B.WORKER_BIRTHDATE, FLOOR(MONTHS_BETWEEN(TRUNC(SYSDATE), B.WORKER_BIRTHDATE) / 12) AS AGE, B.WORKER_ID AS WORKER_ID, B.WORKER_MBTI AS WORKER_MBTI, B.WORKER_NICKNAME AS WORKER_NICKNAME, B.WORKER_NO AS WORKER_NO,
C.AUTHORITY_NO AS AUTHORITY_NO, C.ENROLL_DATE AS ENROLL_DATE, C.MEMBER_DEL_FL AS MEMBER_DEL_FL, C.MEMBER_EMAIL AS MEMBER_EMAIL, C.MEMBER_NAME AS MEMBER_NAME, C.MEMBER_NO AS MEMBER_NO, C.MEMBER_PW AS MEMBER_PW, SUBSTR(C.MEMBER_TEL, 1, 3) || '-' || SUBSTR(C.MEMBER_TEL, 4, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(C.MEMBER_TEL, 8, 4) AS MEMBER_TEL FROM RESUME A LEFT JOIN WORKER B ON A.WORKER_NO = B.WORKER_NO LEFT JOIN MEMBER C ON B.MEMBER_NO = C.MEMBER_NO LEFT JOIN GRADE D ON A.GRADE_NO = D.GRADE_NO WHERE A.RESUME_NO = #{resumeNo}

SELECT A.CAREER_NO AS CAREER_NO, A.COMPANY_NAME AS COMPANY_NAME, TO_CHAR(A.START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS START_DATE, TO_CHAR(A.END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS END_DATE, A.CAREER_DESCRIPTION AS CAREER_DESCRIPTION, A.WORKER_NO AS WORKER_NO FROM RESUME_CAREER B JOIN CAREER_INFO A ON B.CAREER_NO = A.CAREER_NO WHERE B.RESUME_NO = #{resumeNo} ORDER BY A.START_DATE ASC
SELECT B.WORKTYPE_NO, B.WORKTYPE_CATEGORY FROM EMPLOYER_WORKTYPE B JOIN RESUME_WORKTYPE A ON B.WORKTYPE_NO = A.WORKTYPE_NO WHERE A.RESUME_NO = #{resumeNo} ORDER BY 1 ASC
SELECT B.JOBTYPE_NAME AS JOBTYPE_NAME FROM JOBTYPE B JOIN RESUME_JOB_TYPE A ON B.JOBTYPE_NO = A.JOBTYPE_NO WHERE A.RESUME_NO = #{resumeNo}

SELECT DISTINCT A.RECRUITMENT_NO AS RECRUITMENT_NO, A.RECRUITMENT_TITLE AS RECRUITMENT_TITLE, A.RECRUITMENT_CONTENT AS RECRUITMENT_CONTENT, A.RECRUITMENT_DEADLINE AS RECRUITMENT_DEADLINE, A.JOBTYPE_NO AS JOBTYPE_NO, A.NUM_OF_RECRUITMENT_NAME AS NUM_OF_RECRUITMENT_NAME, A.SALARY_NO AS SALARY_NO, A.GRADE_NO AS GRADE_NO, A.PERIOD_NO AS PERIOD_NO, A.DAYS_NO AS DAYS_NO, A.TIME_NO AS TIME_NO, A.EMPLOYER_NO AS EMPLOYER_NO, A.SALARY_MOUNT AS SALARY_MOUNT, A.WRITE_DATE AS WRITE_DATE, A.UPDATE_DATE AS UPDATE_DATE, A.RECRUITMENT_DEL_FL AS RECRUITMENT_DEL_FL, A.MEMBER_NO AS MEMBER_NO, A.RECRUIT_COMPLETE_FL AS RECRUIT_COMPLETE_FL, A.RECRUITMENT_PROFILE AS RECRUITMENT_PROFILE FROM RECRUITMENT A WHERE -- 삭제되지 않은 공고 A.RECRUITMENT_DEL_FL = 'N' AND (
-- 1.학력 조건 A.GRADE_NO = ( SELECT B.GRADE_NO FROM RESUME B WHERE B.RESUME_NO = #{resumeNo})
-- 2. 급여 조건 OR ( A.SALARY_NO IN (1, 2) -- SALARY_NO가 1 또는 2일 때만 희망 금액 비교 AND A.SALARY_NO = ( SELECT B.SALARY_NO FROM RESUME B WHERE B.RESUME_NO = #{resumeNo} ) AND A.SALARY_MOUNT >= ( SELECT B.SALARY_AMOUNT FROM RESUME B WHERE B.RESUME_NO = #{resumeNo} ) )
OR A.SALARY_NO NOT IN (1, 2) -- SALARY_NO가 1, 2가 아닌 경우 SALARY_NO만 비교 AND A.SALARY_NO = ( SELECT B.SALARY_NO FROM RESUME B WHERE B.RESUME_NO = #{resumeNo} )
-- 3.근무기간 조건 OR A.PERIOD_NO = ( SELECT B.PERIOD_NO FROM RESUME B WHERE B.RESUME_NO = #{resumeNo})
----- 여기까진 단순비교 이후로는 1:다 ) --
-- 4.근무요일 조건 OR A.DAYS_NO IN ( SELECT E.DAYS_NO FROM RESUME_DAYSTIME E WHERE E.RESUME_NO = #{resumeNo})
-- 5.근무시간 조건 OR A.TIME_NO IN ( SELECT E.TIME_NO FROM RESUME_DAYSTIME E WHERE E.RESUME_NO = #{resumeNo})
-- 6.근무형태 조건 OR A.JOBTYPE_NO IN ( SELECT F.JOBTYPE_NO FROM RESUME_JOB_TYPE F WHERE F.RESUME_NO = #{resumeNo})
----- 여기까진 1:다 이후로는 다:다) --
-- 7.희망지역 조건 OR A.RECRUITMENT_NO IN ( SELECT DISTINCT D.RECRUITMENT_NO FROM WORKCOND_ADDRESS C JOIN WORKCOND_ADDRESS D ON C.WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_NO = D.WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_NO WHERE C.RESUME_NO = #{resumeNo})
-- 8.업직종 조건 OR A.EMPLOYER_NO IN ( SELECT DISTINCT G.EMPLOYER_NO FROM RESUME_WORKTYPE H JOIN BUSINESS_WORKTYPE G ON H.WORKTYPE_NO = G.WORKTYPE_NO WHERE H.RESUME_NO = #{resumeNo} )
) ORDER BY RECRUITMENT_NO DESC
